---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, improvement or new documentation
title: '[feat] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What user or contributor problem does this solve? Who benefits?

## Proposal

What should change, in concrete terms. Mockups or examples welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches and why this one is better.

## Scope notes

Does it touch `src/domain/` (pure rules), storage, UI text (pt-BR via `t()`),
or docs? Small, reviewable slices are merged faster than big rewrites.
